decisions: JAYA_MASTER_AUTONOMOUS_DEV_GUIDE_v3.md is the highest-authority specification; the v1.0 guide is subordinate compatible detail.
Begin as a bounded modular monolith, preserving module-owned data and public API/event contracts.
No implementation capability may be marked complete without repository evidence and applicable test results.
DOC-001 planning baseline is accepted; FND-001 is the first implementation task.
FND-001 will be delivered as separately reviewable subtasks, beginning with the local executable toolchain before CI and boundary enforcement.
concerns: There is no application, CI, database, authentication, deployment, or monitoring foundation yet.
The eventual production/staging environments and external provider credentials may require later human or cloud-access escalation, but do not block local foundation work.
The baseline requirement count is extensive and must remain mechanically verifiable as statuses change.
FND-001 boundary checks must inspect real source paths and have persistent negative fixtures; checks that merely pass an empty repository are not acceptable.
GitHub currently reports no checks, so CI workflow execution evidence will be required before P0-09 can be accepted.
The event-direction terminology in MODULE_MAP should be watched as contracts are introduced because control-plane events can flow downward even though source dependencies cannot.
last_instruction: Implement and commit the first FND-001 subtask only: add a pinned Node/TypeScript package-manager toolchain, lockfile, minimal platform source/test structure, and working clean-install scripts for build, typecheck, lint, format-check, and test, including at least one real passing assertion; run every command from a clean dependency state and record the exact command results in CURRENT_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md without marking FND-001 or P0-03 through P0-13 complete, and do not add CI, boundary enforcement, database, kernel, business, or UI functionality yet.
